title: Battle of Stalingrad
summary: The Red Army encircles the German 6th Army; the strategic initiative in Europe passes to the Allies.
body: The human cost on both sides was extreme. After Stalingrad, German victory in the east was no longer a serious prospect. Editorial draft for this timeline, not a substitute for specialist literature.

sources.name: Glantz and House, To the Gates of Stalingrad
